headline: BSEC to cut SME board trading threshold to Tk10 lakh from Tk30 lakh
summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission will cut the SME board trading threshold to Tk10 lakh from Tk30 lakh. It reverses its May decision, with the change effective after an amended directive is issued.
why: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission is the country's securities regulator. Changes to trading thresholds affect access and liquidity for small and medium-sized listed companies.
